::: {#exr-why-shrink}

#### Why the gradient shrinks

In a deep MLP, hidden layer $\layeridx$ is $\vhidval_{\layeridx} = g\paren{\vz_{\layeridx}}$ with $\vz_{\layeridx} = \matr{W}_{\layeridx} \vhidval_{\layeridx - 1} + \vecf{b}_{\layeridx}$.
Why does the gradient shrink from layer to layer, going back, when $g$ is the logistic function?

:::
